messages:
claire: Kickoff for HelixCloud co-marketing. Scope: joint benchmark blog, Helix Marketplace listing, and a technical webinar. Targets: webinar 11/16, benchmark blog 11/18, marketplace promo week 11/19-11/25.

ben: Topline goals: drive marketplace-attributed trials, surface p95 latency for conversational workloads, and highlight realistic per-token cost delta.

ramon: Eng will provide a sanitized summary CSV `helix_bench_summary.csv` + a short reproducibility note. ETA Tue. Will include model name, seq_len, and concurrency config.

noor: I'll own landing page and marketplace blurb. Need bench numbers by Wed to finalize copy. Plan to include two audience hooks (Engineering / Product) and CTA `Start marketplace trial`.

claire: Messaging guardrails: use conservative phrasing like "observed up to 31% lower token cost in our benchmark" and link to methodology. No product guarantees. Call out workload shape and test harness.

sam: Ops routing: marketplace leads -> SFDC Campaign = "Helix-MP-1126"; set hidden field origin=helix_marketplace and partner_code=HELX-1126. Create Zap to #sdr-marketplace and auto-assign to `sdr-integrations` queue.

ben: Tracking: utm_source=helix_marketplace, utm_medium=referral, utm_campaign=helix-synd-1126. Hidden form field `partner_id=HELX-1126`. I'll drop the GTM snippet into the LP once it's up.

ramon: Demo artifact: reproducible container `docker run helix/demo:bench-0.3 --port 8080` plus a short runbook. We will not publish raw logs; only sanitized metrics CSV and config snippets.

noor: Landing page A/B plan: 3 headline variants, run A/B for first 72h to optimize registration. I'll prepare social copy for X + LinkedIn and 3 co-branded cards.

claire: Webinar format: 25m joint product + partner overview, 20m benchmark deep-dive, 15m live demo, 10-15m Q&A. Rehearsal week of 11/8. ops-bot: Rehearsal created -> 1841800000 (calendar invite).

sam: Lead handling: rule - if lead.company_size > 100 and intent=POC, escalate to enterprise SDRs within 12h. Else route to integrations pool. Tag leads: marketplace=true, partner=helix.

ben: Retention automation: if marketplace signup uses >12k tokens in first 10 days, alert growth@redwood for Dedicated conversion outreach.

claire: Legal dependency: Helix legal to sign co-marketing brief and logo use by 11/1. If missed, keep internal dry-run; public benchmark post moves to 11/25.

noor: Can we also include a short FAQ and a reproducibility appendix in the blog? I'll draft 6-8 FAQs and a reproducibility section.

ramon: Will scrub any sensitive identifiers before uploading CSV. I'll include exact model, tokenization notes, batch/seq settings.

claire: Action recap: Noor (LP + social + headlines + FAQ), Ramon (bench CSV + demo container + readme), Sam (SFDC rules + Zap + routing), Ben (tracking + GTM + measurement), Claire (partner comms + webinar host). No public comms until legal signoff AND tracking verified.

ops-bot: Reminder set: legal signoff deadline -> 1749990000.

ben: I'll create a GH checklist and link it here. Meeting to finalize Fri 10/28 9am PT. :rocket:
